map.输入吸盘直径、数量、真空度、供气压力与负载，计算吸附力、所需空气流量与响应时间: Enter cup diameter, count, vacuum level, air-supply pressure and load to compute gripping force, required air flow and response time.
map.单吸盘面积 A = π·d² ÷ 4；真空压差 ΔP = 真空度% × 1013: Single-cup area A = π·d² ÷ 4; vacuum differential ΔP = vacuum% × 101325; single-cup grip F = A·ΔP; total grip F_total = n·F; safe grip F_safe = F_total ÷ SF; suction volume V = A × 0.003 × n; required flow Q = V ÷ t (convert to L/min); recommended flow = Q × 1.1
map.真空吸盘选型：由吸盘直径求受力面积，真空度换算为压差（一个大气压 101325: Vacuum-cup selection: derive the loaded area from cup diameter, convert vacuum level to differential pressure (1 atm = 101325 Pa), multiply by area for single-cup grip, by cup count for total grip, divide by safety factor for usable safe grip. Required evacuation flow is estimated as 3 mm-compressed suction volume ÷ target response time, then ×1.1 for line leakage margin, to match the generator rating; when load nears safe grip, enlarge cup diameter or count.
map.💡 吸附力 F=A·ΔP；所需流量 Q=总吸附容积/响应时间（含 10% 泄漏余: 💡 Grip F=A·ΔP; required flow Q=total suction volume/response time (includes 10% leakage margin). Vacuum 70% means ΔP≈70 kPa. Supply pressure affects the generator max vacuum and flow.

map.真空发生器由压缩空气经拉瓦尔喷管驱动，理论极限约 −90 kPa，实际多在 −6: A generator is driven by compressed air through a Laval nozzle; the theoretical limit is about −90 kPa, typically −60 to −85 kPa in practice. Enter the actual gauge reading; the tool caps at 95%.
map.水平搬运一般取 2 以上，垂直提升或高速运动取 3~4，防止冲击、振动与漏气导致: Horizontal handling generally ≥2, vertical lift or high speed 3–4, to avoid drop from shock, vibration and leakage. Increase further for rough or oily surfaces.
